items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: And in the contracts, they had that Wymonie Harris would have to work for straight commission off the door because they wouldn't give him no salary.

ctx.x: And that's the way he throwed away money, see, and that was his publicity. And he used such bad language all the time. We played Los Angeles, California with this show I had, and I was on the air at the Ballroom for a week, and I was on the air at 8:00. And they had in the

contract, Wymonie Harris wouldn't be allowed in the place till 9:00. All the rest of them could go in the show, and if he come, they'd lock the doors and wouldn't let him in, because he'd come up to the radio and start cussing, see.

Then the last tour I made out there, about ten contracts -- and Benny Carter was out there then. And in the contracts, they had that Wymonie Harris would have to work for straight commission off the door because they wouldn't give him no salary. They didn't want him on the contract. So he went along with that, give him a percentage at the door so if he didn't show up it didn't make no difference.
